notes: Wingman is now aware of your saved logins and can act on them. Say "log into this switch with core-admin" (or any saved credential) and it links that login to the device and connects for you.

Your passwords stay private: Wingman knows the credential name, username and description, but never sees the password itself — it's decrypted locally only at connect time and never goes to the AI. It can offer a saved login by name, never a secret.
